name: CrossMA
summary: A moving average crossover EA that generates trade signals when a fast moving average crosses a slow moving average. It enters long when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA and enters short when the fast MA crosses below the slow MA, following the emerging trend direction.
summary_zh: 这是一个均线交叉EA，当快速均线穿越慢速均线时产生交易信号。快速均线上穿慢速均线时做多，快速均线下穿慢速均线时做空，跟踪新兴趋势方向。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双均线交叉，是经典的趋势跟踪方法。入场条件为快速均线穿越慢速均线，上穿做多，下穿做空。出场条件通常为反向交叉信号或固定止损止盈。仓位管理一般采用固定手数或基于资金的动态手数。资金管理可能包含风险百分比计算，但此类基础EA通常缺乏高级资金管理。策略在趋势明显的市场中表现良好，但在震荡行情中会产生大量虚假信号和频繁亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on dual moving average crossover, a classic trend-following approach. Entry conditions trigger when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA for longs and below for shorts. Exit conditions are typically the reverse crossover signal or fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing usually employs fixed lots or account-balance-based dynamic lot calculation. Money management may include risk percentage calculation, but basic EAs of this type typically lack advanced money management features. The strategy performs well in strongly trending markets but generates numerous false signals and frequent losses during ranging or choppy conditions.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points (0 = no stop loss)

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于识别本EA订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying this EA's orders

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和验证
趋势行情中能捕获较大波段利润
参数少，过拟合风险相对较低
代码简洁，便于二次开发和修改
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and verify
Captures significant trend moves in trending markets
Few parameters mean relatively low overfitting risk
Clean codebase, easy to modify and extend
cons: 震荡行情中频繁虚假信号导致连续亏损
均线交叉信号滞后，入场较晚错过趋势初期
缺乏趋势过滤机制，在非趋势市场中仍会开仓
缺少高级风控如移动止损、仓位缩放等
cons_en: Frequent false signals in ranging markets lead to consecutive losses
MA crossover signals are lagging, entering late and missing early trend moves
Lacks trend filter mechanism, opens positions even in non-trending markets
Missing advanced risk controls like trailing stops or position scaling
improvements: 增加ADX或ATR作为趋势过滤器，减少震荡市中的虚假交易
加入移动止损保护已获利润，提高盈亏比
增加多时间框架确认，提高信号质量
improvements_en: Add ADX or ATR as trend filter to reduce false trades in ranging markets
Implement trailing stop to protect profits and improve risk-reward ratio
Add multi-timeframe confirmation to improve signal quality

risk_points: 均线交叉信号滞后可能导致入场点位不佳
缺少趋势过滤器在震荡市中频繁开仓造成资金消耗
如默认止损为0则存在无限亏损风险
risk_points_en: Lagging MA crossover signals may result in poor entry prices
Lack of trend filter causes frequent position opening in ranging markets, draining capital
Default stop-loss of 0 presents unlimited loss risk
